text:
Elaine P: Quick idea—rather than 'battlecard' can we frame launch around a 'performance story' (latency/cost/regression) vs cloud AI vendors?
Samir K: Love it. More concrete: 3 short benchmark vignettes (low-latency checkout, high-throughput embeddings, isolated private deploy).
Zane R: +1. Each vignette needs customer-facing metric hooks: p95 latency, $/1000 tokens, failover time.
Marco V: For webinar, we can demo live routing: hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback. Short clip + slides.
Ari: Routing is important for inbound. Suggest mapping high-intent leads (webinar Qs about SLA/Compliance) to AE queue with private-deploy playbook.
Elaine P: Good. Who can own benchmark writeups? Samir?
Samir K: I can take the low-latency and cost comparison vs cloud. Will need sample prompts and model variants.
Zane R: I'll handle the embeddings throughput slice and bucketized cost math. Need logs from runtime team.
Marco V: I'll do the webinar flow + demo deck. Need a 3-minute pre-recorded fallback demo.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar slot tentative 2026-05-12 10:00 PST. RSVP live in #events.
Ari: For messaging iteration—short microcopy for SDRs: 2 lines on cost delta, 2 lines on SLA, 1 quick CTA (book demo). I can draft.
Elaine P: Sounds like owners assigned. Action items: Samir write benchmark 1 by 4/10, Zane by 4/12, Marco deck by 4/20, Ari microcopy by 4/8. Anyone object?
Samir K: dates ok.
Zane R: ok.
Marco V: ok.
Ari: ok, will draft microcopy and sample follow-up sequences (immediate email + 1-day SDR nudge).
Elaine P: Also: routing rule for webinars in Intercom/HubSpot: tag leads with 'webinar-performance' -> if tag + 'compliance' then AE-team-B, else SDR pool A. Marco can you add mapping?
Marco V: yep, will add mapping and sync with ops.
Elaine P: Great. Next check-in 4/5 at 11am. Thanks :thumbsup:
